content: तिज् I. €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (Strictly {%<ab>desid.</ab>%} of तिज्) (तितिक्षते, तितिक्षित) .²1 To endure, bear. .²2 To put up with, suffer patiently or with courage तितिक्षमाणस्य परेण निन्दाम् <ls>M. 1. 17</ls>; तांस्तितिक्षस्व भारत <ls>Bg. 2. 14</ls>; <ls>Mv. 2. 12</ls>; <ls>Ki. 13. 68</ls>; <ls>Ms. 6. 47</ls>. --II. €10 <ab>U.</ab> or {%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (तेजयति-ते, तेजित) .²1 To sharpen, whet; कुसुमचापमतेजयदंशुभिः <ls>R. 9. 39</ls>. .²2 To stir up, excite, instigate.
